desc: 雪白湖蓝冷调抽切卷纸，齿孔抽幅机制与菱格留白收口
leaf: 三层按需抽切式厨房卷纸提装
name: 按需抽切一抽抵多抽卷纸款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：整包塑封提装立於纯白底，卷顶齐平、无任何文案与角标。
主图一秒法则：一镜讲清顺齿孔按需抽切这一核心利益，左侧三枚空白勾选牌承接主张。
shots.textZone: 顶部 22% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_1}」），左侧三枚空白勾选圆盘标签条（承接「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」）

shots.intent: 放大整张纸擦一处小渍、越擦越多随手成团的真实浪费瞬间，反衬按需抽切的用量控制。
shots.textZone: 左侧 38% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_2}」），纸团与滴渍不入该带

shots.intent: 微距齿孔分段线与压纹分层纸面，用可见结构证明一抽即用而非口头主张。
shots.textZone: 右侧 40% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_3}」），一枚空白细线指示条（承接「{callout_4}」）

shots.intent: 把抽切的半张纸放回真实早餐台面，让家庭买家代入餐后吸液清洁的一刻。
shots.textZone: 左上 30% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_4}」），餐盘与手部不入该带

shots.intent: 单卷与同纸排卷同框等量对照，中间留一枚空白等号牌，把耐用省量讲成可见结构。
shots.textZone: 顶部 24% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_5}」），两枚空白标签条（承接「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」）

shots.intent: 由短到长三档抽切幅端面平铺成阶梯，让买家按污渍量自选用纸档位，消除用量疑虑。
shots.textZone: 三枚空白阶梯长条与下方空白说明行（承接「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」「{callout_9}」），无档位字样

shots.intent: 把抽切小幅纸带进卫浴台面，用非厨房场景扩大买家自我代入的使用面。
宠物进门的脚印一抽擦净，把省量与韧度落到养宠家庭的真实动线里。
以品牌无关的菱格线图案底与空白主张块、空白胶囊按钮收口，只留转化位不编造优惠。
shots.textZone: 中央空白主张块（承接「{selling_point_6}」），下方空白胶囊按钮（承接「{callout_9}」），无数值无机构名

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, flat saturated lake blue #1E7FB8 for the tear-mechanism and equivalence claim screens, flat ice blue #E4EFF6 for the pain-point and size-ladder screens, full-bleed deep ink blue #16323F for the macro, tiled vanity scene and the patterned close card, matte pale porcelain tile #DCE2E6 for the hallway floor scene
style.direction: cool clinical lake-blue household-paper commerce with flat graphic claim screens
style.iconSystem: single-family thin-line outline glyphs in one uniform stroke weight, drawn in pure white #FFFFFF on flat lake blue #1E7FB8 or as hollow check rings rimmed in #FFFFFF, plus blank rounded label plates, no fill, no gradient, no paw print or leaf marks
style.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light around 6000K with a broad front-left key, one large bounce fill and short soft contact shadows only, no warm cast and no amber highlights; the macro lifted by a soft key skimming from camera right; every scene keeps one single shadow direction shared by all props; both groups of any split screen share identical angle, contrast and shadow length
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool clinical lake-blue household-paper ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, flat ice blue #E4EFF6, saturated lake blue #1E7FB8 and deep ink blue #16323F; cool high-key studio lighting around 6000K with a broad front-left key, one large bounce fill and short soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with one heavy display headline block; single-family thin-line icon style drawn in pure white #FFFFFF on flat lake blue discs plus blank rounded label plates; clean high-end paper-fibre texture photography mixed with minimal flat infographic screens; stable upright roll angle and fraction-sheet scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numerals.
noDrift: no invented numerals, units, ply counts, roll counts, conversion equations or ratio marks
no brand wordmark, slogan lettering, certification seal or award artwork anywhere
no warm brown, kraft, terracotta or oak tones anywhere in the set
style.presentationRules: the roll always stands as one upright cylinder with its perforation line and embossed face turned toward the lens; a torn fraction sheet always shows its layered embossed face plus one clean tear edge; the same sheet, embossing and core render identically in every screen; people appear only as hands, forearms or cropped torsos, never as a recognizable face
style.surfaceSystem: honed white stone counter #F5F8FA and matte pale porcelain tile #DCE2E6 as the only real surfaces, brushed stainless holder stems and chrome taps as the only hard metals, flat matte colour fields everywhere else, no wood grain, no kraft, no linen
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one heavy display headline block plus one light sub-line, words are only ever composited later into reserved blank bands, plates, rails and pill buttons
